QuestionStmt.S: The shortest distance between the lines $\vec{r} = (4\hat{i} - \hat{j}) + \lambda(\hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 3\hat{k})$ and $\vec{r} = (\hat{i} - \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}) + \mu(2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 5\hat{k})$ is

Solution.S:
Here, $\vec{a_1} = 4\hat{i} - \hat{j}$, $\vec{b_1} = \hat{i} + 2\hat{j} - 3\hat{k}$.

$\vec{a_2} = \hat{i} - \hat{j} + 2\hat{k}$, $\vec{b_2} = 2\hat{i} + 4\hat{j} - 5\hat{k}$.

$\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1} = -3\hat{i} + 2\hat{k}$.

$$\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2} = \begin{vmatrix} \hat{i} & \hat{j} & \hat{k} \\ 1 & 2 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & -5 \end{vmatrix} = 2\hat{i} - \hat{j}$$

$|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}| = \sqrt{4 + 1} = \sqrt{5}$.

Shortest distance $d = \frac{|(\vec{a_2} - \vec{a_1}) \cdot (\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2})|}{|\vec{b_1} \times \vec{b_2}|}$.

$$d = \frac{|(-3\hat{i} + 2\hat{k}) \cdot (2\hat{i} - \hat{j})|}{\sqrt{5}} = \frac{|-6|}{\sqrt{5}} = \frac{6}{\sqrt{5}}$$

Hence, the correct option is B.
